ambiguities.text: The behavior when the point at infinity is encoded as something other than (0,0) is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only (0,0) encoding is accepted as the point at infinity. Any other representation that mathematically equals infinity but has different encoding would fail the curve equation check.

ambiguities.text: The specification says 'contract fails and all gas is consumed' but doesn't clarify if this includes returning an error code or simply returning empty data.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume failure results in the standard EVM behavior for failed precompile calls: return success=0 with empty return data, and all provided gas is consumed.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'surplus bytes are ignored' is ambiguous about whether input validation should still fail for clearly malformed inputs.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume surplus bytes are simply truncated without error; only the first N bytes (128 for ECADD, 96 for ECMUL) are processed regardless of total input length.

implicit_assumptions.description: The alt_bn128 curve implementation in all Ethereum clients is mathematically correct and produces consistent results.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different clients could produce different results for the same inputs, leading to consensus failures and chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot find valid inputs that cause the precompile to consume excessive computation time beyond what the gas cost accounts for.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DoS attacks could exploit computation/gas imbalance to slow down nodes or cause consensus timeouts.

implicit_assumptions.description: The gas costs (500 for ECADD, 40,000 for ECMUL) accurately reflect the computational complexity across different hardware.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Underpriced operations could be exploited for DoS attacks; overpriced operations would make zkSNARK verification unnecessarily expensive.

implicit_assumptions.description: The discrete logarithm problem on alt_bn128 remains computationally infeasible.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: zkSNARK proofs relying on this curve could be forged, compromising privacy and validity guarantees.
